title: X2CT-GAN
paper_title: X2CT-GAN: Reconstructing CT from Biplanar X-Rays with Generative Adversarial Networks
core_mech: 双正交 2D 编码器将特征提升并融合到 3D，再以体素重建和 3D adversarial loss 联合监督。
core_mech_en: Lifts features from two orthogonal (bi-planar PA + lateral) 2D chest X-rays into 3D via backprojection-inspired feature expansion and cross-view fusion supervised by 3D voxel + GAN losses.
input_desc: 正位与侧位两幅正交 X-ray
input_en: Pair of orthogonal posterior–anterior (PA) and lateral 2D chest radiographs
output_desc: 端到端生成的 3D CT 体

source.title: X2CT-GAN
notes: This is an open-source copyleft license, not a noncommercial license. 'restricted' means obligations beyond retaining a notice; review its source-sharing and compatibility requirements before vendoring.

adapter.name: X2CT-GAN
adapter.mechanism: Two orthogonal image encoders lift features along their missing axes; 3D fusion uses adversarial, voxel and projection losses.
limitations: Small custom encoders/decoder, synthetic orthogonal mean projections; not the original chest-CT model, and two views are required.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
